description:
Add `otto config` subcommands for reading and updating top-level daemon settings without hand-editing YAML.

Subcommands:
- `otto config show` — pretty-print the current config (redact the GitHub token)
- `otto config get <key>` — print a single value by dot-path (e.g. `otto config get agent.default`)
- `otto config set <key> <value>` — update a single value by dot-path and write the config file; validate the new value against the config schema before writing; print the old and new value

Supported settable keys to start: `agent.default`, `pollIntervalMs`, `timeoutMs`, `triggerKeyword` (global default). Per-repo overrides are managed via `otto repo` commands.

Errors clearly when the key doesn't exist or the value fails schema validation.
title: otto config — get and set daemon settings from the CLI
